text: Harbour City leveraged a patient build-up from a corner set-piece, employing just one critical pass over 28.1 seconds to create an overload in the Seabrook Town box, capitalizing on their 4-2-3-1 formation's disciplined structure and short passing style. Marek Barros triggered the key cross to Ravi Varga, whose headed shot was blocked, but Barros opportunistically scored from 43.6 meters with an xG of only 0.009, demonstrating effective exploitation of second-ball transition inside the box [#972] [#973] [#975]. Harbour City’s field tilt of 36.0% and a PPDA of 11.0 indicate moderate pressing and control, allowing them to organize the rest-defense phase before launching the corner attack, enhanced by 54.3% possession and 87.9% pass accuracy in the last 10 minutes. This tactical patience and set-piece efficiency under Tomasz Rhee converted a moment of defensive solidity into a decisive 2-0 lead early in the second half, neutralizing Seabrook Town’s wide crossing threat.
